subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What agent-visible Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw expose for `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, and `name` fields?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing structured JSON passthrough versus command-text augmentation affects Feishu channel compatibility and existing button-command behavior.

options.title: Structured passthrough
options.body: Refresh or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953 so parser, handler, tests, and docs preserve the missing fields without changing simple button commands.

options.title: Form-only first
options.body: Limit the immediate fix to form submissions and leave select/input payload shape to a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Keep command-only callbacks
options.body: Decline general passthrough and require richer Feishu forms to use custom plugin HTTP routes or a future explicit API.

recommendation.title: Structured passthrough
recommendation.body: Refresh or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953 so parser, handler, tests, and docs preserve the missing fields without changing simple button commands.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community-maintained contact for the affected channel plugin.
